discovery_confirm.title: Bold device found
discovery_confirm.description: A Bold device was found. Do you want to set up Bold? You'll sign in with your Bold account next.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: The Bold integration needs to re-authenticate your account.

abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Bold account than the one this entry was set up with.

auth_failed.message: Bold rejected the credentials. Re-authenticate the integration.

bluetooth_unavailable.message: The lock can't be reached over Bluetooth.

firmware_outdated.message: Update the lock's firmware in the Bold app to end activations remotely.

gateway_not_found.message: No Bold Connect is available to reach this lock.

oauth2_implementation_unavailable.message: The Bold application credentials are not available.

rate_limited.message: Too many requests were sent to Bold. Try again later.

unreachable.message: {name} can't be reached through a Bold Connect or over Bluetooth.

update_failed.message: Error communicating with the Bold API: {error}

connect_offline.title: Bold Connect {name} is offline
connect_offline.description:
Bold hasn't heard from the Bold Connect **{name}** since {last_seen}, so {locks} can't be unlocked through it.

Check that the Bold Connect is powered and connected to Wi-Fi; unplugging it for a few seconds usually helps. Locks in Bluetooth range of Home Assistant can still be unlocked over Bluetooth.

lock_out_of_range.title: {name} is out of Bluetooth range
lock_out_of_range.description:
**{name}** can only be unlocked over Bluetooth, because it has no Bold Connect or its unlock method is Bluetooth only, but Home Assistant hasn't heard it since {since}.

Add an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy near the lock, or check that the one near it is working. If the lock is only in range some of the time, you can ignore this; you'll only be told again if it goes out of range again after being heard.

lock_no_route.title: {name} can't be unlocked from Home Assistant
lock_no_route.description:
**{name}** has no Bold Connect, and Home Assistant has no Bluetooth to reach it directly.

Add a Bold Connect to the lock in the Bold app, or give Home Assistant Bluetooth, for example with an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy near the lock.
